title: Civitai and Australia: which bitGen Studio features it affects
lines: Civitai has been blocking visitors from Australia since 16 March 2026. That came a week after Australia's age-check codes for online services took effect on 9 March 2026.
bitGen Studio talks to Civitai from your computer. In Australia, these parts can't reach it:
- Model manager ▸ Civitai: search, the filters and ⤓ download
- 🔄 Sync, ⤓ Civitai info and 🔍 look it up on Civitai (details, thumbnails, examples, SHA-256 lookups)
- Pods: finding a model the pod needs on Civitai (by its card, its SHA-256 or its name) so the pod downloads it
When Civitai can't be reached, bitGen says so in the log and carries on with the next way it has.
- The models and LoRAs already on your computer, and Civitai details already saved in model_info
- bitGen's download list (Hugging Face) and the links you add yourself
- Sending a model from your computer to a pod, or through your private Hugging Face repo
Nothing has been removed. The Civitai features stay in bitGen Studio for everyone outside Australia, and each one carries a note in the feature list.
